title: A line does not break inside a monospace code span
body: text::wrap breaks at any space, including one inside a run in the mono font. In figures/key-schemes.acre, step 3 breaks `key_at(text, i + 21)` into `key_at(text, i +` and `21)`. A break should prefer a space outside inline code, and fall back to one inside only when the code span alone is wider than the width.
